company.name: Capmo
company.shortDescription: Capmo is developing construction management platform to make the hard things in construction feel easy.
company.description:
Capmo is the leading B2B SaaS startup revolutionizing one of the largest yet most antiquated industries in the world, construction and real estate. We have been awarded multiple times as one of the most innovative construction tech companies and have tripled our team in 3 years to nearly 70 employees from more than 15 countries. By the end of 2022, we will define the digital future of the construction industry in Germany, Austria and Switzerland so that homes, schools and hospitals, among others, can be built on time, on budget and CO2-efficiently in the future. 

The Munich-based software startup was founded in 2018. Several hundred customers and tens of thousands of users in Europe already rely on Capmo's digital solution and implement well over 10,000 construction projects with the software.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,557,462, or 80.16% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,114,395 to $132,870,177, a 13.14x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
